name: Scarlet Monastery: Whitemane's Deep Sleep ends when she re-engages (#5172)
contract: At 50% health High Inquisitor Whitemane (3977) runs actionlist 397700: she stops attacking, turns passive and casts Deep Sleep 9256, whose effect 0 applies aura 12 SPELL_AURA_MOD_STUN with TargetA 22 / TargetB 15 = enemies around the caster in radius index 12 = 100 yd, pets included (no player-only attribute). Setting her data 1 1 starts timed event 1 after 200 ms when Scarlet Commander Mograine (3976) stands within 5 yd (conditions source group 17), which runs actionlist 397701: Scarlet Resurrection after 4500 ms, say after 1900 ms, sheath after 1400 ms, emote, then after 2000 ms she resets invincibility, turns aggressive and attacks, about 10 s after the sleep. Stock 3.3.5 Deep Sleep has DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms, so the sleep ended as she re-engaged; the former AzerothCore C++ script waited 7 s for it to run out. CoA's Spell.dbc (Ascension patch-T) gives it DurationIndex 3 = 60000 ms without aura interrupt flags, the up-to-1-min duration Ascension shows, so the players and their pets stay asleep for about 50 s while she and Mograine attack. Expected: the player and the Witch Hunter's Shadowhound (50124) still sleep during the resurrection and both wake when she re-engages, far short of the 60 s aura duration.

steps.label: Survive Whitemane's attacks for the whole encounter phase
Keep the Shadowhound alive for the whole encounter phase
Whitemane puts the player into Deep Sleep
Whitemane puts the Shadowhound into Deep Sleep
The player still sleeps while Whitemane resurrects Mograine
The Shadowhound still sleeps while Whitemane resurrects Mograine
The player wakes when Whitemane re-engages, not after the 60 s aura duration
The Shadowhound wakes with the player
Waking was not caused by death
